tools.name: ryla_generate_base_image
tools.description: Generate base character images from a niche/vibe/prompt. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generate_face_swap
tools.description: Swap a character face onto a reference base image. Returns the generation result.

tools.name: ryla_generate_character_sheet
tools.description: Build the 18-shot identity reference sheet for an existing character (the live replacement of the retired character sheet; flat, no extra credits). Use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId. Returns a sheetJobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generation_status
tools.description: Check the status of a generation job by its jobId.

tools.name: ryla_account_credits_balance
tools.description: Check the authenticated user's current RYLA credit balance.

tools.name: ryla_account_gallery_list
tools.description: List the authenticated user's most recent generated images/jobs.

tools.name: ryla_list_characters
tools.description: List the authenticated user's existing characters (AI influencers) so you can pick a characterId for the other generation tools. `loraReady` tells you whether `useLora: true` has a trained LoRA to use. There is no tool to CREATE a character -- that happens in the RYLA app at app.ryla.ai.

tools.name: ryla_generate_image
tools.description: Generate Studio-quality images for an existing character with full creative control (scene, outfit, pose, lighting, expression, style). This is the primary, full-featured image tool -- prefer it over ryla_generate_base_image. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a character

tools.name: ryla_upscale_image
tools.description: Upscale one of your own generated images (2x or 4x, faithful, no new content). Costs credits. imageId comes from ryla_generation_status (output.imageIds) or ryla_account_gallery_list. Returns a job; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_character_reference_images
tools.description: Get fresh URLs of a character's reference material: its base image and the 16-shot reference sheet. Pass any of these as referenceImageUrl to ryla_generate_image to keep the face consistent. URLs expire after about an hour. Read only: never regenerates anything.

tools.name: ryla_generate_video
tools.description: Generate a video from an existing character image (image-to-video, Wan 3.0). Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId. By default the newest completed image of the character is animated; pass sourceImageId (imageIds from ryla_account_gallery_list) to pick one. Pri

tools.name: ryla_generate_voice
tools.description: Generate speech audio (TTS) in an existing character's voice. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId.

tools.name: ryla_generate_avatar_video
tools.description: Generate a talking avatar video from a character face + an audio track (kie.ai InfiniTalk). Pro plan required. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generate_video_swap
tools.description: Swap a character face into an existing video (face swap onto uploaded footage). Pro plan required. videoUrl must be a video you already uploaded to your RYLA account. Character must already exist; use ryla_list_characters to find a characterId. Returns a jobId; poll with ryla_generation_status.

tools.name: ryla_generate_lip_sync
tools.description: Generate a talking video by lip-syncing a portrait image to an audio track (kie.ai InfiniTalk). Both portraitImageUrl and audioUrl must be RYLA-hosted URLs you own. Pro plan required. This capability may not be available on your account yet (internal rollout, pricing not finalized) -- an unavailable

tools.name: ryla_list_templates
tools.description: Find RYLA templates (ready-made looks: scene, outfit, pose) by name or tag. Returns template ids. Pass an id as `templateId` to ryla_generate_image to generate your character in that template. Unrestricted (NSFW) templates are only listed when `unrestricted` is true.

tools.name: ryla_server_info
tools.description: Get RYLA external MCP server configuration and connection info
